items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Doubles Down on U.S. Housing
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway nearly doubled its stake in home builder Lennar, adding to its bet on the U.S. housing industry, while confirming its position in Italian web-services firm Bending Spoons.

items.title: Nucor (NUE) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher As Analysts Weigh Growth Against Cost Pressures
items.summary: Price targets on Nucor have shifted, with bullish analysts now pointing to a US$300 to US$345 range, while more cautious views cluster around US$280 to US$296. This split reflects differing emphasis on longer term earnings power and cash generation versus nearer term guidance, cost pressures and policy risk, which feeds directly into how much analysts are prepared to pay for the stock.
